name: print-social-marketing-posts-violet-with-pink-highlighter-and-halftone-photos
title: Marketing pack in violet and white with pink highlighter words, halftone photos and grid lines
whatItIs: Nine square posts in violet and white with a fine grid, violet halftone-tinted photos of smiling people, headlines like 'The solution is here!' and 'Make your brand grow' where a word is hot pink with a scribbled highlighter stroke, sparkle stars and browser dots.
whatItMeans: Upbeat and digital; halftone and highlighter strokes give a printed, hand-marked energy.
techniques: Tint photos in a halftone of the brand colour.
Mark key words with a scribbled highlighter stroke.
Use a faint grid for a digital notebook feel.

vocabulary.definition: A rough marker line behind a word.
A dot-screened photo in one colour.
